text:
IncidentBot: Pager alert — api-gateway-prod > 5xx spike (502/504) across edge POPs. active_hits: 18% above baseline, error_rate: 12%
Mira: I'm on it. what region?
IncidentBot: Spike primarily in eu-west-1 and us-central, small blip in ap-southeast. Traffic fanout shows increased upstream 502s to autograph-gateway.
Mira: @Tony can you confirm if any recent edge deploys or config pushes?
Tony: No infra deploys in last 2 hours. There was an auth-service rollout an hour ago — but that's internal. Quick check: routing table shows higher retry counts to L7 pool 7.
Priya: Customer-impact: support queue reports ~15 tickets from EU customers complaining about intermittent failures when saving documents. CS triage estimates ~low->medium impact but hitting paying customers.
Sam: Not seeing backend CPU pressure. Nginx conn logs show lots of backend aborts with "upstream prematurely closed connection" and 504 on long tails. Could be a proxy timeout or a misbehaving upstream process.
Mira: Start mitigation plan: 1) Enable regional fallback to secondary pool for eu-west-1 2) Temporarily increase gateway upstream timeouts 3) Attach circuit-breaker for autograph-gateway. I'll coordinate.
Tony: Agreed. I'll flip regional fallback and enable CB. Making change now.
Console Bot: Runbook step initiated by Mira: "eng-sre / api-gateway 5xx spike" — channel logged.
Tony: Running command to add fallback route:
```
gwctl route update --region eu-west-1 --service api-gateway --fallback-pool-id pool-secondary-3 --apply
```
Tony: Applied. Confirming propagated to edge nodes (checking telemetry).
Sam: Telemetry shows drop in error fanout in eu-west-1 within 30s of route change — error_rate down from 14% -> 7% (prelim).
Priya: Noting in CS: file a short customer status note: "Investigating intermittent API errors in EU, mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m."
Mira: Next: increase upstream timeout to avoid 504s while we assess backend health. Tony, please bump read timeout to 90s.
Tony: Bumping now:
```
gwctl config set --service api-gateway --upstream-timeout 90000
```
Tony: Timeout set. Propagating — edge nodes will pick up in ~20s.
Sam: After timeout change, 504 tail decreased but 502 immediate errors still at ~5%. Logs show a repeating pattern: upstream /auth/sign endpoint returning 502 on keepalive reuse.
Mira: Rollback candidate: there's a recent change in autograph-gateway v2.1.3 — consider rolling it back to v2.1.2 in eu-west-1 only. Tony, can you trigger a canary rollback?
Tony: Starting canary rollback for autograph-gateway in eu-west-1 to v2.1.2 for 10% of traffic:
```
orchestrator rollout --service autograph-gateway --region eu-west-1 --version v2.1.2 --weight 10
```
Tony: Canary in progress. Monitoring logs.
IncidentBot: Alert: Canary deployment started at 1704209250 by Tony.
Sam: Canary nodes show healthy responses; 502s on those nodes are near 0. Overall cluster error rate trending down to 3% after canary.
Priya: CS update posted: "Mitigation underway; partial fallback and timeout increases reduced errors; canary rollback running. We'll update in 15m or on major change."
Mira: Good. Keep watch on slow queries. Also add a temporary alert to mute noisy downstream retries so we don't amplify.
Tony: Added short silence to noisy alert channel and configured a rate-limiter on retries at edge:
```
gwctl rate-limit set --service api-gateway --retry-window-ms 200 --max-retries 2
```
Tony: Rate limiter applied.
Sam: Seeing reduced retry storms. Error rate holding ~2-3%. Latency slightly up due to timeout increase but within SLO for now.
Mira: Action items: Tony — finish rollback to v2.1.2 in eu-west-1 if canary stable (ok to proceed). Sam — gather heap/core dumps from autograph nodes for postmortem. Priya — prepare customer Slack note and timeline draft. I'll own incident timeline and severity classification.
Tony: Canary stable for 5 minutes. Proceeding to full rollback in eu-west-1.
Console Bot: Orchestrator job queued: rollback eu-west-1 autograph-gateway to v2.1.2 (initiated by Tony)
Tony: Rollback completed at 1704209580. Confirming all eu-west-1 autograph nodes on v2.1.2.
Sam: Post-rollback metrics: eu-west-1 error_rate down to 0.9%, global to 1.4%. 504s nearly resolved.
Priya: Customer note updated and sent to affected customers. Support queue triaged — severity labels set.
Mira: Wrapping: incident reduced, ongoing monitoring for 30m, postmortem to include root-cause of upstream keepalive/502s and rollout safeguards. Assigning follow-ups: rollback playbook, improved canary metrics, and a change in default upstream timeout logic.
Sam: I'll collect logs and attach to the postmortem doc.
Tony: I'll run a correlation query across deploys and upstream errors and share findings.
IncidentBot: Incident status -> acknowledging: mitigation succeeded, monitoring phase. Pager cleared. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
Mira: Thanks team. If anything regresses ping here immediately.
Priya: Filed customer incident summary in CS-DB and notified account owners.
Sam: leaving monitoring on for 30m.
Mira: closing handoff to post-incident channel when we start the RCA."
